title: Expro secures major integrated services contract for Newfoundland life-extension campaign

body_markdown:
Expro has secured a multi-product line contract to support a major Canadian operator’s life-extension campaign offshore Newfoundland, Canada


The award will see Expro provide integrated well services across Well Construction, Well Flow Management, and Subsea Well Access for a 14-well campaign, with options for additional wells. The work is expected to commence in Q1 2027.


With the harsh operating environment offshore Newfoundland, Expro’s strong track record in this domain will help optimize project design and minimize operational risk. That experience includes supporting previous campaigns offshore Eastern Canada with high-specification equipment in complex operating conditions, giving Expro a deep understanding of the practical challenges of delivering work safely and efficiently.


The multi-product line scope is designed to reduce interface complexity by bringing several well intervention services into a coordinated package across the campaign.


**Gregorio Rodrigues, Regional Vice President for North and Latin America at Expro, said:** *“This award reflects the value of combining local experience with integrated capability in one of the world’s most demanding offshore environments as the campaign moves into an important phase of intervention and workover activity.*


*“By bringing multiple services together into a single, coordinated scope, we can reduce complexity and support safer, more efficient execution for our customer.”*
